description: This file implements the 'Edit' feature for articles in a web application, handling updating article details and associated tags using MediatR request handlers, validation, and Entity Framework Core ORM operations.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: Contains nested types and handler for editing an article, including command models, validation, and the handler logic for updating article data and tags.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the command to update an article, updating fields, managing tags, and saving changes in the database.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToCreate
methods.description: Determines which tags need to be added to the article based on the provided tag list.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToDelete
methods.description: Determines which tags should be removed from the article based on the provided tag list.
